verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken reflow. The RSVP CTA shrinks to a small pill the same size as FREE ENTRY, so the call to action is buried. The badge row is split into scattered pairs, with ALL AGES/TASTINGS stranded at the bottom away from their group. A large grey placeholder box dominates the lower right. The micro legal text sits above it. The left text column wraps awkwardly ('Live music / and rooftop / pours') and is jammed beside the oversized phone. A has slightly tighter margins: the headline and 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' run close to the right edge, and its placeholder box is bigger. B has a little more breathing room. However, B's TASTINGS pill is noticeably larger than ALL AGES, which makes the badge sizes inconsistent. B is only marginally less cramped.
